title: Short Stirling W7473, Handley Page Halifax HR832 and Bristol Blenheim Z7278
memorial_details: description: A MEMORIAL TO THE AIRCREW WHO DIED/ WHEN THEIR AIRCRAFT CRASHED IN/ THE PARISH OF CLENCHWARTON/ STIRLING W 7473/ 218 SQUADRON/ RAF MARHAM/ CRASHED IN INGRAMS FIELD/ 23rd APRIL 1942 / (NAMES)/ HALIFAX HR 832/ 404 (VANCOUVER) SQDN/ RAF GRANSDEN LODGE/ CRASHED AT/ CLIFTON FARM/16TH JUNE 1943/  (NAMES) MOSQUITO ...../ (NAMES)/ HURRICANE .../(NAME)/ OXFORD .../ (NAMES)/  MAY THEY REST IN PEACE
